newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo net profit edges higher in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Akzo net profit edges higher in Q3.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV on Wednesday announced virtually unchanged third quarter net profit and said full-year net before extraordinary items would be "about level" with the 1995 figure.
Net profit came in at 328 million guilders ($193.4 million) versus 324 million guilders a year earlier, with operating profits at 510 million guilders versus 494 million guilders.
Analysts had forecast third quarter net of 298-364 million guilders.
The interim dividend was unchanged at 1.50 guilders per share.
"As stated earlier, we expect that for the full year net income before extraordinary items will be about level with 1995," Akzo said in a statement.
Turnover increased to 5.49 billion guilders from 5.22 billion guilders.
Net profits including extraordinary gains for the first nine months dipped to 1.027 billion guilders from 1.113 billion guilders in the same 1995 period.
